text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - USDA said private exporters reported sales of 132,080 tonnes of corn to Japan for delivery in the 1996-97 marketing year.
WHEAT SALE - The U.S. Agriculture Department will donate 15,000 tonnes of wheat to a private volunteer group to distribute in Benin.
WHEAT SALE - The Australian Wheat Board confirmed it sold 500,000 tonnes of wheat to Pakistan.
BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission invited tenders for the supply of 25,000 tonnes of barley for shipment by May 20, 1997. Tenders close on April 15.
BARLEY TENDERS - The South African Wheat Board said it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale no later than April 30.
BARLEY TENDERS - The South African Wheat Board said it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale no later than April 30.

WHEAT TENDERS - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association will tender on Tuesday for two 34,000-tonne wheat shipments from the United States, traders said Thursday. The two shipments are slated for delivery from the PNW at April 25-May 15 and May 15-June 5.
- USDA's Commodity Credit Corp said it will tender April 15 to buy 25,470 tonnes dark northern spring wheat for donation to Ghana. The wheat was due for May 1-25 shipment.
- The Philippines plan to buy 65,000 tonnes of wheat for May or June shipment, Manila grains traders said.
WHEAT OFFER - Syria offered 50,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for June shipment. Bids were due April 15.
RICE TENDER - Costa Rica will tender on April 30 for 26,500 tonnes optional origin long grain rough rice or 18,000 tonnes long grain milled rice.
- Syria seeks 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20. April 8 is the final date for bids and result will be announced on April 16.
- South Korea is expected to hold a tender at the end of June to buy 77,000 tonnes of rice to meet its 1997 quota under the World Trade Organization, U.S. Agriculture officials said.

MARKET TALK - USDA signed a PL480 pact with Sri Lanka for the purchase of 55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat....EU oilseed area was forecast to rise 3.2 percent to 5.54 million hectares, EU sources said....China's corn export program, which could already total two million tonnes this year, may grind to a halt if Japan does not become a more active buyer, traders and diplomats said....South Korea will face chronic annual rice deficits of up to 300,000 tonnes a year within five years, forcing it to become a significant annual importer of table rice, a U.S. embassy report said....U.S. corn exports to South Korea were forecast to fall by 2.6 million tonnes in the 1996-97 marketing year due to fierce competition from China and Argentina, the U.S. embassy said....The Australian Wheat Board confirmed it sold 500,000 tonnes of wheat to Pakistan.
